extDescription.message: Switch between Claude accounts and see 5-hour and weekly usage. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

cmdSwitchNext.message: Switch Claude to the next account

common_notAffiliated.message: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" is a trademark of Anthropic.

error_sessionExpired.message: Session expired. Log in to this account again, then save it.

error_rateLimited.message: Claude is limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.

error_server.message: Claude's servers had a problem. Try again later.

error_timeout.message: Claude took too long to answer. Try again.

error_offline.message: Can't reach Claude. Check your internet connection.

error_notSaved.message: The {site} account you're logged in with isn't saved. Save it first so it isn't lost.
error_notSaved.description: {site} is a site name, e.g. Claude or Console.

error_notLoggedIn.message: You're not logged in to {site}. Log in first, then save.

error_needTwo.message: Save at least two accounts to switch between them.

error_noneAvailable.message: No other account is ready. All are near their limit or have no usage data yet.

error_restoreFailed.message: Couldn't restore that account's session. Log in to it again and save it.

error_noBackground.message: The extension is restarting. Close this and try again.

bg_badge_window.description: Toolbar tooltip: one usage window, e.g. 5-hour: 93%

bg_badge_stale.message: Usage may be out of date
bg_badge_stale.description: Toolbar tooltip hint when usage was not refreshed for a while

bg_switched_message.description: Notification text after an automatic switch. reason is a short phrase like: 5-hour limit at 95%

bg_limitNear_message.description: Notification text. reason is a short phrase like: 5-hour limit at 95%

bg_rotated_message.description: Notification text after the keyboard shortcut switched account

options_poll_help.message: How often the extension asks Claude for your usage. 1 to 60 minutes.

options_threshold_help.message: An account at or above this usage counts as near its limit.

options_auto_desc_off.message: Nothing happens when an account gets near its limit.

options_auto_desc_notify.message: You get a notification when an account gets near its limit.

options_auto_desc_switch.message: Switches to another account when the current one gets near its limit.

options_auto_warn.message: Switching reloads open Claude tabs and can stop a reply that is still being written.

options_cooldown_help.message: Minimum wait between automatic actions. 0 to 240 minutes.

options_strategy_best_desc.message: Picks the account with the most usage left.

options_strategy_nextAvailable_desc.message: Goes in order, but skips accounts that are near their limit.

options_strategy_next_desc.message: Goes to the next account in your list.

options_rotation_note.message: Used by the Switch to next button, the keyboard shortcut and auto-switch. Auto-switch never picks an account near its limit.

options_shortcut_help.message: Switch to the next account from anywhere in Chrome.

welcome_heading.message: Welcome to Account Switcher for Claude

welcome_subtitle.message: Switch between your Claude accounts in one click and keep an eye on your 5-hour and weekly limits.

welcome_step1_text.message: Click the puzzle-piece icon in the Chrome toolbar, then the pin next to Account Switcher.

welcome_step2_text.message: Log in to claude.ai, open the extension and click Save this account.

welcome_step3_text.message: Click Add account, log in with the next account and save it. Your other accounts stay saved.

welcome_tip_shortcut_text.message: Switch to the next account from anywhere in Chrome.

welcome_tip_auto_text.message: When an account gets near its limit, we can notify you or switch for you. Turn it on in Settings.

welcome_terms.description: {link} is replaced by a link with the text of welcome_terms_link

popup_reset.description: Usage window already reset. Lowercase, shown in small text.

popup_shortFiveHour.description: Very short label for the 5-hour usage limit, next to a small meter.

popup_shortWeekly.description: Very short label for the weekly usage limit, next to a small meter.

popup_unsavedBanner.message: You're logged in to {site} with an account that isn't saved yet.
popup_unsavedBanner.description: {site} is a site name, e.g. Claude.

popup_sitesLabel.description: Accessible label for the Claude / Console tabs.

popup_accountsLabel.description: Accessible label for the account list.

popup_activeAccount.description: {label} is the account name. Accessible name of the row of the account in use.

popup_moreActions.description: {label} is the account name. Accessible name of the ... button.

popup_removeConfirm.message: Remove {label}? It only forgets it here.

popup_saveCurrent.description: {site} is a site name, e.g. Claude.

popup_loginAnother.description: {site} is a site name, e.g. Claude.

popup_status.description: Footer status line. {strategy} and {auto} are short phrases.

popup_emptyStep1.message: Log in to claude.ai in this browser.

popup_emptyStep2.message: Open this popup and save the account.

common_privacy.message: Your saved sessions stay in this browser and are only sent to Claude. Nothing is sent to us. Anyone who can use this browser profile can use them.

common_updateCheck.message: The extension checks GitHub once a day for new versions.

error_usageUnavailable.message: Couldn't read this account's data. Try again later.

bg_badge_windowLimiting.description: Toolbar tooltip: the usage window closest to blocking, e.g. Weekly: 99% (limiting)

popup_windowResets.description: Shown under an account name when a usage limit is nearly used. {time} is a duration such as 2h 11m.

popup_addMoreWays.message: More ways to add an account
popup_addMoreWays.description: Accessible name of the small arrow button next to Add account that opens a menu of sites.
